props.description:
Product master data for manufacturing operations. Each product represents an item that can be produced, with associated cycle times, yields, and specifications.

**Key Use Cases:**
• Product catalog management
• OEE target configuration (cycle time, yield)
• Work order product selection
• Quality and production reporting

props.label: Code
props.description:
**`code`** (`String!`)
Unique product identifier.

- Must be unique across all products.
- Format: `{FAMILY}-{TYPE}-{SEQ}` (e.g., BRK-PAD-001).
- Used in work orders and production logs.

props.label: Name
props.description:
**`name`** (`String!`)
Descriptive product name.

- Displayed in selection lists and reports.
- Should be human-readable and descriptive.

props.label: Product Family
props.description:
**`productFamily`** (`String`)
Product grouping category.

- Examples: Brake Components, Sauces, Polymers.
- Used for filtering and reporting by product category.

props.label: Unit
props.description:
**`unit`** (`Unit`)
Unit of measure for this product.

- Examples: Each (ea), Kilograms (kg), Liters (L).
- Used for quantity tracking and inventory.

props.label: Cycle Time (s)
props.description:
**`standardCycleTime`** (`Float`)
Ideal cycle time in seconds.

- Time to produce one unit at standard rate.
- Used for OEE Performance calculations.
- Lower = faster production.

props.label: Target Yield (%)
props.description:
**`targetYield`** (`Float`)
Target quality yield percentage.

**Color Coding:**
• 🟢 ≥98.5% (Green) - Excellent
• 🟡 95-98.5% (Amber) - Acceptable
• 🔴 <95% (Red) - Below target

Used for OEE Quality calculations.

props.label: Setup Time (min)
props.description:
**`setupTime`** (`Float`)
Standard setup/changeover time.

- Time in minutes to changeover to this product.
- Used for production planning and scheduling.
- Impacts OEE Availability during changeovers.

props.label: Status
props.description:
**`isActive`** (`Boolean`)
Product active status.

**Color Coding:**
• 🟢 **Active** (Green) - Available for production
• 🔴 **Inactive** (Red) - Not available

Inactive products cannot be selected for new work orders.

props.label: Created At
props.description:
**`createdAt`** (`DateTime!`)
Record creation timestamp.

- Auto-generated when product is created.
- Used for audit trails.

props.label: Created By
props.description:
**`createdByUser`** (`User!`)
User who created this product.

- Auto-populated from logged-in user.
- Displays full name.

props.label: Product Code
props.description: Filter by product code. Partial match supported.

props.label: Description
props.description:
**`description`** (`String`)
Detailed product description including specifications.

- May include dimensions, materials, or customer-specific details.
